biggest_catch: Your friend's referred loan must be new (not already financed with CoastLife), over $10,000, approved, and funded - and the amount doesn't pay out unless the loan closes.
catches: Refer a Loan: receive $100 for yourself and $100 for the referred friend or family member when the new loan is approved and funded.
The loan must be a new loan (not currently financed with CoastLife CU) of over $10,000, approved and funded.
This offer cannot be combined with any other offer; other restrictions may apply.
Rewards are paid once the loan is funded; the form is submitted to CoastLife CU who handles the rest.

Submit the form with your friend's or family member's details.
